projectDescription: A smart Alfred workflow for inserting BibTeX citations in multiple formats (Pandoc, LaTeX, Multi-Markdown, org-mode, and more) and managing references directly from macOS.
keyFeatures: System-wide citation insertion via Alfred hotkey or keyword trigger
Smart fuzzy search across title, author, year, journal, citekey, and keywords
10+ citation formats: Pandoc, LaTeX, Multi-Markdown, org-mode, eta, wikilink, tag, iA Writer, and more
Add new BibTeX entries from DOI, ISBN, or URLs via Universal Action
Automatic PDF renaming and filing by citekey
Literature note creation and Obsidian vault integration
Support for two simultaneous BibTeX libraries
Paste full formatted bibliographies using Pandoc and CSL styles
Online CSL style search and download from the official repository
Blazingly fast buffer with smart invalidation (sub-200ms reload for 4000+ entries)
publicApiSurface: Universal Action — add entry from selected DOI/ISBN/URL
Hotkey trigger — open citation picker from any text field
workflow variable: open_entries_in (BibDesk, Zotero, VS Code, Sublime, Neovim, default app)
Citation format: formatted single entry (via Pandoc)
